wrong_response: Absolutely, here's how to make them: Mix together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt in a bowl. In another bowl, beat eggs, milk, melted butter (or oil), and vanilla extract until smooth. Combine wet ingredients with dry ones and stir just enough to moisten the batter; lumps are fine. Fold sliced bananas into half of your pancake mixture for a marbled effect in each pancake, then cook on a hot griddle or non-stick skillet until golden brown, flipping once. Top with warm syrup and enjoy!
